element: SM x-load PRE-QUANTISED block-dot mode (x_fmt 3) for quantize-before-gather consumers
source: rtl/hbm_accel/generic/peers/ot_hgi_sm_xload_static_cl2p.sv (+ ot_hgi_sm_xload_static_cl2.sv from main for the shared leaves)
format: PRE-QUANTISED VM FORMAT v1: S<=4 segments x Bs blocks; record at word base + p*x_stride/8 + s*ss: Bs code words (E4M3, element j at [8j+:8]) then Es=ceil(Bs/32) exponent words (byte k = e(block 32g+k)+127)

master_swaps.note: all other ports identical; fmt 0/1/2 cycle-identical (bench +SAME=1, D=0)

master_swaps.ports: same as ot_hbm_xp_aq_tree13 (clk, rst_n, v=pv_*, fp4=0, x=l_d_o half, vo->po_*, q, e, y open, fault->pf_*)
master_swaps.placement: beside each quantiser tile (same l_d_o source, same BD-ring sink)

compiler_constants.fmt3_shift_edges: D = P*S*Es + 3: every xw beat and x_done of fmt 3 = fmt 1's on the same vector D edges later
compiler_constants.vm_reads: NE = P*S*Es exponent-preload waves (8-bank, one per edge) from the command start, then fmt 1's 8-bank issue pattern shifted by D; code and exponent reads never share an edge (no bank conflict)
